compounds.quote: detected in all experimental cheeses at high levels (Figure 3A), particularly during warm room ripening, with a mean level of ~50 mg/kg of cheese at 11 d (start of warm ripening) and ~4,000 mg/kg of cheese at 41 d (end of warm room ripening).
compounds.name: propanoic acid

ammonia.reason: Short 4-8 week ripening with limited amino acid deamination gives low NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Washed pasteurized curd with no Brevibacterium, no p-cresol/indole formation.

bitter.reason: Washed curd removes lactose and hydrophobic rennet peptides; Propionibacterium peptidases debitter.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone at background.

browning.reason: Curd washing removes residual lactose/galactose limiting Maillard to moderate whey-protein browning.

buttery.reason: High diacetyl 2057 ug/kg from citrate metabolism by Lc. lactis biovar diacetylactis/Leuconostoc.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic acid ~2 mg/kg and <200 mg/kg over 6 mo from limited lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 27.4% fat ~48% FDM in 42.2% moisture washed-curd matrix gives smooth lubrication.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic cohesive Swiss-type paste with gas eyes, not dry crystalline fracture.

firmness.reason: 42.2% moisture semi-hard propionic eye body is elastic-firm, not hard-grana.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism in young interior.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from heterofermentative ethanol plus fatty acids via esterases.

goaty.reason: 100% cow milk fat, no goat-specific caproic/caprylic/capric branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Propionibacterium freudenreichii propionate ~4000 mg/kg plus Strecker aldehydes and proline give Swiss-nutty note.

melt.reason: pH 5.57 calcium-para-casein with 42% moisture and 27% fat gives excellent flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface mold; linoleate-derived 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one near detection limit.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-oil release from 48% FDM on heating with stable young emulsion.

sour_vinegar.reason: High propionic/acetic from warm-room propionic fermentation buffered at pH 5.57, washed curd low lactic acid.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata gel with no hot-water casein fiber alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low-heat cooked washed curd, minimal methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMS.

sweet.reason: High pH 5.57-6.13, low salt 1.36% plus propionate and diacetyl impart sweet perception.

umami.reason: Moderate rennet/plasmin and starter proteolysis in 2-mo cheese yields glutamate peptides.
